news.title: Sangguniang Panlalawigan Declares Alcala CY 2026 Annual Budget (₱260.23M) Operative
news.summary: Provincial Resolution No. 580-2026 declared Alcala’s CY 2026 Annual Budget of ₱260,232,497.00 (Municipal Appropriation Ordinance No. 2025-03) operative in its entirety.
news.details: Approved during the Sangguniang Panlalawigan session on May 11, 2026, the CY 2026 budget includes a ₱234,783,497.00 National Tax Allotment (NTA) share and reiterates compliance with DBM-DOF-DILG Joint Memorandum Circular No. 1 for the 20% Development Fund.

citation.sourceTitle: Provincial Resolution No. 580-2026 — Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Pangasinan

news.title: Sangguniang Panlalawigan Declares Alcala FY 2025 Annual Budget (₱230.31M) Operative
news.summary: Provincial Resolution No. 319-2025 declared Alcala’s FY 2025 Annual Budget of ₱230,306,279.00 (Municipal Appropriation Ordinance No. 2024-04) operative in its entirety.
news.details: The Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Pangasinan reviewed and affirmed Appropriation Ordinance No. 2024-04 enacted on December 2, 2024, noting that the 20% Development Fund from the National Tax Allotment must adhere to DBM-DOF-DILG Joint Memorandum Circular No. 1.

citation.sourceTitle: Provincial Resolution No. 319-2025 — Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Pangasinan

news.title: Public Advisory: Mandatory CCTV Installation Ordinance for Barangays & Businesses
news.summary: Municipal Ordinance No. 2025-04 requires all 21 barangays and commercial establishments in Alcala to install operational CCTV systems as part of public safety and business compliance.
news.details: Business owners renewing or applying for Mayor’s Permits at the Alcala Business Permits and Licensing Office (BPLO) should verify CCTV camera placement requirements under Municipal Ordinance No. 2025-04.

citation.sourceTitle: Municipal Ordinance No. 2025-04 (SP Pangasinan Legislative Review)
citation.issuingAgency: Sangguniang Bayan of Alcala / SP Pangasinan

news.title: Community Program Notice: Local Resident Employment Priority in Alcala Projects
news.summary: Municipal Ordinance No. 2025-06 mandates contractors and private projects operating in Alcala to prioritize qualified local residents.
news.details: Jobseekers residing in any of Alcala’s 21 barangays are encouraged to register with the Public Employment Service Office (PESO) and secure a Barangay Residency Certificate for project hiring referrals.

citation.sourceTitle: Municipal Ordinance No. 2025-06 (SP Pangasinan Legislative Review)
citation.issuingAgency: Sangguniang Bayan of Alcala / SP Pangasinan

news.title: 2024 Census Update: Alcala Population Reaches 49,479 Residents
news.summary: PSA 2024 Census of Population (POPCEN) places Alcala, Pangasinan at 49,479 residents across 21 barangays, up from 48,908 in 2020.
news.details: While municipal-level 2024 POPCEN totals are confirmed, individual 2024 barangay breakdowns remain partially released; BetterAlcala continues to display the verified 2020 PSA Census baseline for all 21 barangays alongside updated 2024 figures where published.

news.title: Annual Statutory Reminder: Business Permit Renewal & Q1 Real Property Tax Deadlines
news.summary: Under the Local Government Code (RA 7160), annual business permit renewals and first-quarter Real Property Tax payments fall due every January 20 and March 31 respectively.
news.details: Residents and business owners in Alcala should confirm exact local BOSS schedule extensions directly with the Municipal Treasurer or BPLO at (075) 632-5938.

citation.sourceTitle: Republic Act No. 7160 (Local Government Code of 1991)
citation.notes: Statutory national deadline shown; confirm any LGU Alcala Sangguniang Bayan grace period resolutions.

news.title: Emergency Preparedness Notice: Agno River Monitoring & Ambulance Guidelines
news.summary: Keep verified Alcala MPS ((075) 593-2829), Alcala RHU ((075) 593-4992), and National 911 saved for monsoon or Agno River flood advisories.
news.details: Municipal Ordinance No. 2026-05 also establishes formal policies and guidelines for ambulance and patient transport use across Alcala’s 21 barangays.

citation.sourceTitle: Alcala Emergency Contact Directory & Municipal Ordinance No. 2026-05
